findings.observation: Terminology tab is asserted only on its loaded state (line 256 findByText Terminology Configuration toBeVisible). No deferred terminology call and no failing terminology call is set up anywhere in the file; getAllTerminology is only mocked resolved (openSettingsAt lines 179-195).

If the failure copy is undecided, the design owner decides it; the oracle may assert role alert plus no empty area until then.

findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/pages/Settings/Organization/organizationTabs.test.tsx:505 (Usage Data tab, shows a spinner while the settings are on their way)
findings.obligation: E5 loading look for Usage Data; S2 acceptance row: spinner while loading. The RED must be the missing loading look, observed semantically.
findings.observation: Line 505 expect(await screen.findByRole(progressbar)).toBeInTheDocument() fails with Error: expect(element).toBeInTheDocument() element could not be found in the document. The progressbar was found and then removed before the assertion ran, so the observed RED is a timing artifact (likely the settings-level access spinner), not the features loading look. Same risk in no other test of this file, since the Refresh spinner test first waits for refresh-interval-Team.
findings.remediation: Wait for the Usage Data tab to be selected (for example findByRole tab named Usage Data with aria-selected true) before asserting the progressbar, and assert the spinner is still present while slowFeatures is pending; keep the toggle-absent check. Re-record the RED so the failure is the missing features spinner.
